title: Raw rational completed coefficient categories on actual slices
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with integers $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and an arbitrary scheme $X$. On the global site or an actual slice indexed by $U:\operatorname{Option}(X_{\mathrm{proet}})$, use the completed ring $R_{E,U}$, module complexes, ambient derived category $D_U$ and ambient Hom of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Restrict the canonical constant coefficient section to this site. Its multiplication on complexes descends to the central action on $D_U$, hence gives its specified $\mathcal O_E$-linear structure. Define $\mathrm{Rational}_U$ to be the raw scalar localization $D_U[1/\varpi_E]$ of [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization], with unchanged objects, and $q_U$ its actual tensor-with-one functor. Define the coefficient object to be $R_{E,U}$ in degree zero. Site and coefficient universes remain independent.
